disclaimer: Research/demo only—not clinical advice or diagnosis. All cases are synthetic, non-patient placeholders written for this demonstration; none derives from any real study, label, report, image or model output.

cases.title: Low concern / routine review
cases.expected_reason: Synthetic inputs are structurally consistent, quality is OK and there are no warnings, so the deterministic consensus reports complete evidence for research review.

cases.title: Multiple evidence items / reviewer attention
warnings: Synthetic engine note A: an input slice group is flagged for reviewer attention.
Synthetic engine note B: a second evidence item is flagged.
cases.expected_reason: Quality is flagged REVIEW and two synthetic engine warnings are present, so the consensus asks for more evidence before the evidence is treated as complete.

cases.title: Uncertain evidence / request more evidence
cases.expected_reason: The synthetic quality assessment was never run (NOT_ASSESSED) and no supporting evidence references exist, so the consensus requires more evidence.

cases.title: Data-quality limitation
warnings: Synthetic data-quality limitation: the simulated input could not be evaluated.
cases.expected_reason: The simulated evaluation reported UNABLE_TO_EVALUATE and produced no usable values, so the consensus reports inference unavailable.

cases.title: Mandatory human escalation
warnings: Synthetic contradiction: status says OK but no values were recorded.
cases.expected_reason: The synthetic record is self-contradictory (status OK without values), so the consensus flags inconsistent evidence and a human should escalate.
